params.name: statuses
params.description: Filters clients based on status. Can be one of 'Online' or 'Offline'.

params.name: ip
params.description: Filters clients based on a partial or full match for the ip address field.

params.name: ip6
params.description: Filters clients based on a partial or full match for the ip6 address field.

params.name: ip6Local
params.description: Filters clients based on a partial or full match for the ip6Local address field.

params.name: mac
params.description: Filters clients based on a partial or full match for the mac address field.

params.description: Filters clients based on a partial or full match for the os (operating system) field.

params.name: productType
params.description: The product type to fetch events for. This parameter is required for networks with multiple device types. Valid types are wireless, appliance, switch, systemsManager, camera, cellularGateway, wirelessController, campusGateway, and secureConnect

params.name: includedEventTypes
params.description: A list of event types. The returned events will be filtered to only include events with these types.

params.name: excludedEventTypes
params.description: A list of event types. The returned events will be filtered to exclude events with these types.

params.name: deviceMac
params.description: The MAC address of the Meraki device which the list of events will be filtered with

params.name: deviceSerial
params.description: The serial of the Meraki device which the list of events will be filtered with

params.name: deviceName
params.description: The name of the Meraki device which the list of events will be filtered with

params.name: clientIp
params.description: The IP of the client which the list of events will be filtered with. Only supported for track-by-IP networks.

params.name: clientMac
params.description: The MAC address of the client which the list of events will be filtered with. Only supported for track-by-MAC networks.

params.name: clientName
params.description: The name, or partial name, of the client which the list of events will be filtered with

params.name: smDeviceMac
params.description: The MAC address of the Systems Manager device which the list of events will be filtered with

params.name: smDeviceName
params.description: The name of the Systems Manager device which the list of events will be filtered with

params.name: eventDetails
params.description: The details of the event(Catalyst device only) which the list of events will be filtered with

params.name: eventSeverity
params.description: The severity of the event(Catalyst device only) which the list of events will be filtered with

params.name: isCatalyst
params.description: Boolean indicating that whether it is a Catalyst device. For Catalyst device, eventDetails and eventSeverity can be used to filter events.

params.name: perPage
params.description: The number of entries per page returned. Acceptable range is 3 - 1000. Default is 10.

params.description: The email of a network user account or a Systems Manager device

params.description: The MAC of a network client device or a Systems Manager device

params.description: The serial of a Systems Manager device

items.docs:
List the keys required to access Personally Identifiable Information (PII) for a given identifier. Exactly one identifier will be accepted. If the organization contains org-wide Systems Manager users matching the key provided then there will be an entry with the key "0" containing the applicable keys.

## ALTERNATE PATH

```
/organizations/{organizationId}/pii/piiKeys
```

params.name: t0
params.description: The beginning of the timespan for the data. The maximum lookback period is 30 days from today.

params.name: timespan
params.description: The timespan for which the information will be fetched. If specifying timespan, do not specify parameter t0. The value must be in seconds and be less than or equal to 30 days.

params.name: deviceType
params.description: Filter the data by device type: 'combined', 'wireless', 'switch' or 'appliance'. Defaults to 'combined'. When using 'combined', for each rule the data will come from the device type with the most usage.

params.name: perPage
params.description: The number of entries per page returned. Acceptable range is 3 - 1000. Default is 1000.

params.name: startingAfter
params.description: A token used by the server to indicate the start of the page. Often this is a timestamp or an ID but it is not limited to those. This parameter should not be defined by client applications. The link for the first, last, prev, or next page in the HTTP Link header should define it.

params.name: endingBefore
params.description: A token used by the server to indicate the end of the page. Often this is a timestamp or an ID but it is not limited to those. This parameter should not be defined by client applications. The link for the first, last, prev, or next page in the HTTP Link header should define it.

params.name: serials
params.description: Optional parameter to filter devices by serials. All devices returned belong to serial numbers that are an exact match.
